jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern, Infrastructure
jobs.description_text:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.
At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.
We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.
Software Engineer Intern, Infrastructure
Talos is seeking an Software Engineering Intern to join our Infrastructure team for the Summer 2027. As an Software Engineering Intern on the Infrastucture team at Talos, you will work alongside engineering teams to build, scale and maintain the system that powers Talo’s trading and settlement platform. The team is made up of engineers that know building great systems takes time, and we spend the time to ensure the safety, security and performance of our platform. We value strong communication skills and the ability to get things done in a collaborative environment.
This internship will run for 12 weeks.
 
Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go:
 
https://github.com/talostrading/sonic
Responsibilities
Collaborate with the team to design, maintain and scale infrastructure systems
Contribute to automation initiatives, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment tooling
Support the performance of production systems through monitoring, logging and observability improvements
Cross-functionally communicate with teams to understand and implement infrastructure requirements
Be part of an open and transparent culture
Ideal Experience
Class of 2028 pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
Experience with one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or similar)
Familiarity with Linux systems, shell scripting and/or networking fundamentals
Exposure to cloud platforms and online hosting (e.g. AWS, GCP)
Interest in distributed systems and platform engineering
Demonstrated development experience (applicable coursework, projects, internships, etc.)
Experience in either crypto or finance, or a strong desire to learn
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Local to London HQ

jobs.description_text:

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.
At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.
Software Engineer Intern, Trading
Talos is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join our Trading team for the Summer 2027. This intern will work on a critical project related to our high-performance trading systems, contributing to tools that support trading decision-making and performance evaluation. Success in this role will involve designing and building components that enhance our algorithmic capabilities while adding new features to existing infrastructure.
Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: 
https://github.com/talostrading/sonic
Responsibilities 
Collaborate with the Trading team to define project scope, requirements, and milestones
Prepare design documentation and actively participate in architectural discussions with team members
Build features in Go to enhance Talos's Order Management System (OMS), which is responsible for making all trading related decisions for orders submitted into Talos to ensure best execution
Add analytics and metrics to measure impact of your changes while incorporating feedback and iterating based on team input
Demonstrate project progress through regular demos
Qualifications
Class of 2028 pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field
Proficiency in at least one compiled language (e.g., Go, C++, Java)
At least one previous internship involving working on backend systems in a production environment, preferably in a user-facing context
Knowledge of relational databases (e.g Postgres)
Past experience with trading systems is a plus
Detail-oriented, self driven, analytical, and enthusiastic about working on impactful projects
Strong communication skills, with an ability to convey technical concepts clearly
Ability to work autonomously as well as a part of a collaborative team environment
Energetic, creative, and a self-starter who can manage tasks autonomously

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Support (London, United Kingdom)
jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a leader in our Product Support organization, you'll have the opportunity to lead and grow our Technical Support team for EMEA, ensuring we effectively identify, investigate, and resolve complex product issues at scale. You'll continue to shape this function - setting strategy, hiring and developing high-performing talent, defining how we partner with Product and Engineering, and building the systems needed to improve product quality for our customers, including our most strategic Enterprise users.

You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Support Operations, and Enterprise Support to strengthen feedback loops, improve workflows, and drive meaningful product improvements. This role requires balancing technical depth, customer experience, and operational excellence. We're looking for a leader who is passionate about developing people, thrives in complexity, and brings structure and clarity to a high-growth, evolving environment.

This role will be hybrid from our London Hub.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Build and lead the Technical Support function in EMEA, setting a high bar for technical excellence and customer experience
  • As a builder and coach, you'll lead and empower the team to meet KPIs across Technical Support
  • Partner with Product Support Operations to design and implement scalable processes for bug triage, investigation, and resolution
  • Collaborate closely with our engineering partners to ensure high-quality bug reporting and strong feedback loops
  • Use data and insights from Product Support Analytics to surface trends, improve product quality, and inform strategic decision-making
  • Coach and develop team members across Enterprise and Technical Support, emphasizing technical depth and career growth
  • Support high-complexity Enterprise escalations, ensuring consistent, high-quality technical outcomes

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Leadership & SaaS Experience: 4+ years leading high-performing technical support teams in a SaaS environment, with a focus on supporting enterprise customers.
  • Technical & Debugging Acumen: Strong background in debugging and technical quality, with the ability to interpret developer documentation and APIs, and working knowledge of web technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS).
  • Enterprise Support Expertise: Experience supporting complex enterprise environments, including workflows related to SSO, SCIM, provisioning, and security.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Scaling: Proven ability to partner with cross-functional partners to resolve issues and drive improvements, while also being comfortable building new systems and processes from scratch.
  • People Management & Development: Deep expertise in people leadership and a passion for developing effective, high-performing teams.

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience using Figma's products
  • Background in developer-facing or API-heavy support environments

jobs.title: Systems Associate (Graduate/Entry-level opportunity)
jobs.description_text:
Hi, I'm Tom Clark - CIO, CISO, and hx employee #9. I'm the executive in charge of our Systems & Security function. I joined in 2020 at seed stage, and I've been here through Series A, Series B, and everything in between - watching us grow from nine people to more than 250. I’m six years in, and I've never been more excited about what's ahead.
Fun fact: I didn't come from insurance. I came from TV and media - if you've ever used BBC iPlayer, ITVX, or listened to Capital Radio, I helped make them. I ended up in insurance and became, perhaps unexpectedly, one of the industry's biggest cheerleaders.
I know what you're thinking: insurance isn't cool. I can change your mind in five minutes, or your money back. And the best bit? What we're building with hxOS is cooler still. We take a product-centric, customer-centric view to internal IT - the same rigour and craft you'd bring to any customer-facing product. That's what makes this role different, and it's what I'm most excited about.
Let’s speak soon.
- TC
 
About hyperexponential (hx)
At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are decisions that shape real-world outcomes - whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 60 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do: from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
About the SYSSEC team
hxOS is hx's internal operating system. It's the platform every person in the company uses and builds on: devices, meeting rooms, core applications, SSO, AI tools, data infrastructure, security and compliance. The Systems & Security (SYSSEC) team builds it, runs it, and keeps improving it. It'll never be finished. That's the point.
hxOS is as much a vision as a current reality. The foundations are solid, day to day runs well because it has to, nothing gets built on shaky ground. The more ambitious layers - federated, AI-native, product-led infrastructure that the whole business builds on - are what the team is building now.
About the role
The Systems Associate is one of the most visible faces of SYSSEC. They're the first point of contact for everything coming into the team, and the work ranges widely: a day might move from troubleshooting a device, to helping a team get more out of a new AI integration, to contributing to a piece of infrastructure the whole company will rely on. What ties it together is ownership: of the service experience, of the queue, and progressively of the platform itself.
The career story here is real. This person becomes hxOS's internal expert, the colleague people turn to when they want to understand what's possible, get more out of their tools, or navigate something new. That's a rare combination of technical depth, operational credibility, and genuine impact at the centre of how the company works.
This is an Associate/IC1 role, suited to a talented graduate or someone with a year or two behind them.
What you'll be doing
Own the front door.
